title: Allocation-lock timeout hint must report the break file alloc.lock.break and stop calling alloc.lock safe to remove unconditionally
description: Follow-up from the QCLI-495 narrow review (team-lead, opum-doc earlier ruling: a named error showing the exact file, never auto-clearing). The timeout hint in src/cli/main.ts (the IdAllocationLockTimeoutError branch, about :4809-4819) never mentions <common-dir>/quest/alloc.lock.break. A break file left by a breaker killed between creating and writing it is never auto-cleared (unreadable pid), blocks breaking a stale alloc.lock, and today the hint says removing alloc.lock is safe, which is wrong while a live break holder exists. Not started.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The allocation-lock timeout hint reports whether alloc.lock.break is present and its holder (the pid, or the word unreadable).
The hint says removing alloc.lock is safe only when there is no live break holder, and names the exact break file path when one exists.

The hint never removes or clears the break file by itself; a test fixture with a live-pid break file and one with an unreadable break file each assert the hint text, and the test goes red when the break-file clause is removed.

plan: 1. Read the task and the QCLI-495 allocator: the timeout error carries the lock path, holder pid and age but nothing about alloc.lock.break, and the hint in main.ts calls the lock safe to remove unconditionally.

2. Extend IdAllocationLockTimeoutError with breakPath, breakFilePresent, breakHolderPid (null = unreadable) and breakHolderAlive, populated in acquireLock timeout branch from readLock on the break path.

3. Move the hint text into allocationLockTimeoutHint in the application layer so it is testable without a ten-second spawn; the three states are: absent, present with a LIVE holder (removal NOT safe), present with an unreadable or dead holder (blocks breaking a stale lock, name the file, never clear it).
4. main.ts uses the shared builder and adds breakPath/breakFilePresent/breakHolderPid to input.

5. Tests in test/qcli522-alloc-lock-break-hint.test.ts: three text assertions, plus two end-to-end fixtures in a real repo (live-pid break file; zero-byte break file beside a stale lock) asserting exit 5, the hint text and that the break file is left untouched.
6. Mutation control: remove the break clause and confirm the tests go red, then restore.
7. bun run check on bun 1.4.2, commit on fix/QCLI-522-alloc-break-hint, push, open the PR, report the head SHA.
